from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np,json
from scipy.linalg import qr,solve_triangular
p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
source=(p.parent/'rain-articulation-factorization/run.py').read_text().split('rng=np.random.default_rng')[0]
exec(compile(source,str(p/'setup-factorization.py'),'exec'))
def sqrt_psd(A):
 values,vectors=np.linalg.eigh(A);assert min(values)>=-1e-12*max(1,max(abs(values)));return (vectors*np.sqrt(np.maximum(values,0)))@vectors.T
Ms=sqrt_psd(m.M);Gs=sqrt_psd(m.G[np.ix_(r.free,r.free)]);Jf=m.J[r.free];A=np.concatenate([Jf@Ms,Gs],axis=1);assembly=float(max(abs(A@A.T-r.Hff).flat));assert assembly<=1e-10
A32=np.concatenate([Jf.astype(np.float32)@Ms.astype(np.float32),Gs.astype(np.float32)],axis=1)
qr_factors=[]
for ii in groups.values():
 R=qr(A32[ii].T,mode='economic')[1];assert R.dtype==np.float32;qr_factors.append((ii,R))
def qrsolve(rhs):
 out=np.zeros(len(rhs),dtype=np.float32)
 for ii,R in qr_factors:out[ii]=solve_triangular(R,solve_triangular(R.T,rhs[ii].astype(np.float32),lower=True))
 return out.astype(np.float64)
rng=np.random.default_rng(20261006);cases=[('random-'+str(i),rng.normal(size=r.N)) for i in range(24)]
for arm in ['cold','capped']:cases.append((arm,np.load(p.parent/'rain-interior-global-budget'/(arm+'.npz'))['impulses'][r.remaining]))
records=[]
for name,y in cases:
 rhs=-(m.g[r.free]+r.Hfr@y);want=r.recover(y);vref=m.M@m.J.T@want;x=want.copy();x[r.free]=qrsolve(rhs);res=float(max(abs(r.Hff@x[r.free]-rhs)/(1+abs(rhs))));v=m.M@m.J.T@x;verr=float(max(abs(v-vref)/(1+abs(vref))));records.append(dict(case=name,free_residual=res,velocity_difference=verr,pass_screen=res<=1e-5 and verr<=1e-5))
result=dict(status='qr-screen-pass' if all(v['pass_screen'] for v in records) else 'qr-screen-failed',assembly_error=assembly,cases=len(records),failed=sum(not v['pass_screen'] for v in records),max_free_residual=max(v['free_residual'] for v in records),max_velocity_difference=max(v['velocity_difference'] for v in records),records=records,scope='Float32 QR and triangular solves; original float64 RHS formation and original float64 velocity reconstruction. Not a complete float32 solver.')
